Description
The page: five sections drawn from the read model and from nothing else, each with an empty, a loading, and an error state beside its ready one. Every value reaches the page as JSON and is written as text; nothing loads from anywhere but this origin.
Design
The page's own script draws the sections from /api/standing and /api/throughput. The words are the terminal's wherever the terminal has them.
Acceptance criteria
Every section renders in every state from fixtures under the render test; every value is escaped under the content security policy; the renders are golden files.
